as_told.title: Psionic assets screened from third world countries

plain: People with supposed psychic powers, called "psionic assets", are said to be sought out in other countries, screened and brought to secret sites. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he flew a recovered UFO, tells Michels that there are operations "OCONUS", military shorthand for outside the continental United States, "where prospecting for psionic assets takes place and they're highly coveted". The line comes back in later episodes, and Michels himself retells it, saying Barber spoke of such people being rounded up in disaster zones, "in sometimes some not so ethical ways". Michael Herrera, who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, repeats Barber as saying the assets are screened from third world countries. The UFO researcher Steven Greer goes further, calling it trafficking, placing it in Indonesia and saying the people are moved to covert places "where they'd be screened, tested".
